cases.label: Field count
cases.text: A field's count adds the outcomes still in play twice.

cases.label: Old reading as current
cases.text: An opening reading, or a final one with no result yet, is shown as the current combined probability.

cases.label: Shrinking list
cases.text: When loading fails, a list of the closest markets quietly gets shorter instead of saying so.

cases.label: Settled by our clock
cases.text: A market is marked settled by our own clock before its venue has graded it.

cases.label: Midterms preview
cases.text: The midterms preview changes the probabilities it shows, or drops markets that have one.

cases.label: Redone work
cases.text: A change in which markets belong to a group makes the accuracy record redo work it had already saved.

cases.label: Desktop unlock
cases.text: On desktop, a game unlocks before the reader has scrolled to it.

cases.label: Invented prop result
cases.text: A general settlement source makes up a result for a prop.

cases.label: Even split, no trades
cases.text: A market nobody has traded shows an even split, as if it had a probability.

cases.label: Someone else's lock
cases.text: A process that does not hold a refresh lock can delete it.

cases.label: Field count rename
cases.text: An internal setting in the field-count code gets a new name. Nothing a reader sees changes.

cases.label: Headline rename
cases.text: A name inside the code behind a page's headline probability is changed. Nothing a reader sees changes.

cases.label: Loading rename
cases.text: A name inside the loading code is changed. Nothing a reader sees changes.

cases.label: One expression, one place
cases.text: An expression repeated in the cards-seen code is written once and reused. Nothing a reader sees changes.

cases.label: Result kept
cases.text: A result is stored before it is turned into a yes or no. Nothing a reader sees changes.
